lineage: Separate finite pilot of the already-registered G9QR mechanism. Uses G9QR data/objective family but 160 fixed updates on all three inherited G8C verified-trace seeds.
hypotheses: H1: query-conditioned sequence-level contrastive ranking improves both-correct counterfactual memory pairs versus matched-compute positive-NLL control.
H2: the same objective increases query sensitivity without increasing wrong-other-key confusion.
H3: the memory-specific objective does not regress a fresh mixed reasoning suite by more than 2 percentage points.
optimizer: restore G8C AdamW state; stage3 LR cosine 0.0002 to 0.00004; betas/weight_decay from parent; clip1

objective.query_contrast: mean positive sequence NLL + 0.5*mean softplus(0.5 + nll_positive - nll_counterfactual_answer)
objective.nll_control: mean positive sequence NLL + 0.0*mean softplus(0.5 + nll_positive - nll_counterfactual_answer); negative candidates still scored in identical tensors
objective.sequence_score: length-normalized NLL of F=<integer> plus EOS

data.split_rule: query-invariant history canonical groups split before rendering; all query variants of one history stay in one split
data.denied: all available G5S parent and G8C fresh canonical groups; G8C held never used for training

free_generation: prompt strings only; greedy byte259; max32 new bytes; EOS required; exactly F=<integer>; no solver/case/gold input
selection: fixed step160 endpoints only; validation/held never select checkpoint or hyperparameters
scope: small memory-addressing mechanism screen; not300-800M, not broad reasoning/code evidence, not Qwen parity
